# Route an Intent through the Router
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `command.route.command` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/command.yaml` |
| Tags | command |
Classifies the free-text task, scores candidate routes, and dispatches
the winner via the YAML runtime.
Wired as `localfabric route run <task>` on the CLI and as
POST /v1/route on the API surface (Phase C3).

### Run Operations
#### Python
_No operation description provided._
```python
# Bridge: invoke the Python router from inside the YAML runtime.
import json, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "02_core")
from core.router.router import Router  # noqa
from core.runtimes.yaml.src import Runtime  # noqa: F401
# Note: the bridge approach is intentional — `command.route.command` is
# the user-facing wrapper; the Router class composes
# classifier/scorer/dispatcher and itself calls runtime.execute
# on the chosen route. We pass a fresh Runtime instance the Router
# constructs internally rather than threading the current scope.
router = Router()
result = router.route(task="{{ task }}", context={{ context | tojson }})
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"dispatch_result": str(result)}, f, default=str)
```
